response.sql: WITH event_name_averages AS (SELECT e.event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS average_budgeted_amount FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event GROUP BY e.event_name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_budgeted_amount) AS mean_average FROM event_name_averages) SELECT a.event_name, a.average_budgeted_amount, a.average_budgeted_amount - o.mean_average AS amount_above_mean, a.average_budgeted_amount / o.mean_average AS ratio_to_mean FROM event_name_averages AS a CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE a.average_budgeted_amount > o.mean_average;
